page.overview:
Who is Zenare Ghodar?

Zenare is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of .

She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size. Barring some below average ability in the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai.

She was not present when Nynaeve al'Meara Healed both Leane Sharif and Siuan Sanche from stilling and insisted on her going through the whole process again step by step and even tries to give advice on how to improve it.
